concerns.text: FR‑008 requires the pipeline to halt if any core construct (discount rate, procrastination score, WM metrics) is missing from the dataset after ingestion. Task T070 only enforces a fail‑loud check on missing *files*, not on missing variables, leaving the specification unimplemented and effectively weakening the requirement.

SC‑005 (and FR‑010) demand that the total analysis runtime ≤ 6 hours and memory usage ≤ 7 GB. While T075 records resource usage, there is no verification task that asserts the recorded values meet the specified limits, making the success criterion untestable and constituting a silent weakening of the specification.
